contact.department: Harris County Appraisal District (HCAD) GIS Division

counties.notes: Harris County, Texas (Houston metro, pop. 4.7M, county seat Houston) is the most populous Texas county and third-most populous in the US. The data authority is HCAD, Harris Central Appraisal District, which maintains property appraisal records independently of the county government. 62 fields confirmed, including HCAD_NUM (parcel ID), acct_num, owner_name_1/2/3 (up to three ownership slots with own_pct_1/2/3 percentage shares), site_str_num, site_str_name, site_city, site_zip, mail_addr_1/2/3, mail_city, mail_state, mail_zip, land_use, land_value, bld_value, total_appraised_val, new_owner_date, and yr_impr. Owner name is public under the Texas Public Information Act; Texas Tax Code §25.025 allows certain categories of persons (peace officers, judges, domestic violence victims, and others) to request suppression of their home address from appraisal district records. Owner-name LIKE query confirmed live. Max record count = 1000 per query. The HCAD open-data hub at geo-harriscounty.opendata.arcgis.com provides bulk downloads. A sibling service on the same server covers HCAD_MUD (Municipal Utility District) boundaries.

contact.department: Travis County Transportation & Natural Resources (TNR) GIS

counties.notes: Travis County, Texas (Austin metro, pop. 1.3M, county seat Austin) is home to the state capital and the University of Texas at Austin. The REST layer ("TCAD Parcels", an ArcGIS Online hosted FeatureServer, ~386,682 parcels) is sourced from Travis Central Appraisal District (TCAD) and published through Travis County Transportation and Natural Resources (TNR) GIS. Searchable fields: PROP_ID (property ID), PID_10 (10-character parcel key), and SITUS (combined situs address). Owner name is NOT included. Travis County publishes the parcel geometry and identifiers as a public layer while keeping ownership data behind TCAD's property search portal at traviscad.org. For owner-name lookups, search traviscad.org by address or property ID. Texas Tax Code §25.025 permits certain persons (peace officers, judges, domestic violence victims, and similar categories) to request that their home address be withheld from appraisal records; such records may appear with address fields redacted at TCAD's portal. The county's former on-premise endpoint at gis.traviscountytx.gov/server1 went offline in 2026 (the ArcGIS host returned an HTTP 500 .NET host error); this hosted FeatureServer is the current public source. Open-data hub: tnr-traviscountytx.opendata.arcgis.com.

ownerFieldNote.body: Owner name isn't in Travis County / TCAD's public REST layer. It exposes Property ID (PROP_ID), the 10-character parcel key, and situs address only. Search by property ID or address below, or look up the owner of record at the Travis Central Appraisal District.

contact.department: Tarrant County GIS / Tarrant Appraisal District

counties.notes: Tarrant County, Texas (Fort Worth / Arlington metro, pop. 2.1M, county seat Fort Worth) is the fourth-most populous Texas county. The data authority is TAD, Tarrant Appraisal District. 56 fields confirmed including TAXPIN, ACCOUNT, OWNER_NAME, SITUS_ADDR, OWNER_ADDR, OWNER_CITY, ZIPCODE, DEED_DATE, DEED_BOOK, DEED_PAGE, YEAR_BUILT, LIVING_ARE, BEDROOMS, BATHROOMS, SW_POOL, LAND_ACRES, APPRAISEDV, LAND_VALUE, IMPR_VALUE, and TOTAL_VALU. Owner-name query via UPPER() LIKE on OWNER_NAME returns real results. Texas Tax Code §25.025 (address-confidentiality program) permits certain protected persons, peace officers, judges, domestic violence victims, and similar categories, to request that their address be withheld from public appraisal records; records subject to §25.025 may not appear in REST query results or may appear with address fields suppressed. A sibling TADParcelsApp/MapServer/0 exists on the same server but carries only TAXPIN geometry. It is the display layer for TAD's parcel viewer and has no attribute data. TAD open-data hub: gis-tad.opendata.arcgis.com. Tarrant County open data: data-tarrantcounty.opendata.arcgis.com.

contact.department: City of Dallas GIS / Dallas Central Appraisal District (DCAD)

counties.notes: 41 fields confirmed including ACCT (17-digit DCAD account number), TAXPANAME1/2 (taxpayer names), TAXPAADD1-4, TAXPACITY, TAXPASTA, TAXPAZIP, ST_NUM, ST_NAME, ST_TYPE, ST_DIR, CITY, COUNTY, SCHOOL, SPTBCODE (special purpose district), PROP_CL, BLDG_CL, LEGAL_1-5, MAPSCO_GR, TOTEXEMPT, BUSNAME, PROPNAM, ResCom, APPRAISALYEAR. Owner search uses TAXPANAME1 (the taxpayer of record). APPRAISALYEAR in live records reads 2019. The authoritative real-time DCAD parcel lookup is at dcad.org; the gis.dallascounty.org REST server does NOT expose a public parcel service (only SampleWorldCities and CommissionerDistricts). This layer covers all of Dallas County, not just the City of Dallas city limits. CITY field contains the incorporated municipality (Dallas, Rowlett, Garland, Irving, etc.). The COUNTY field confirms 'DALLAS COUNTY' for all records. Texas Tax Code §25.025 (address-confidentiality program for protected persons, peace officers, judges, victims of family violence, etc.) may suppress some owner names in a future data refresh; query TAXPANAME2 as fallback. maxRecordCount=1000.

dataVintage.body: This layer is a DCAD annual-export snapshot, its APPRAISALYEAR field reads 2019. Account numbers, owner names, and addresses still locate a parcel, but for the current owner of record and 2025 appraised value, use DCAD's live records. It covers every incorporated city in Dallas County via the CITY field (Dallas, Garland, Irving, Rowlett, and the rest), not just the City of Dallas.

BCAD's own server (bcad.org) does not expose a public REST parcel endpoint. maxRecordCount=1000. Texas Tax Code §25.025 (address-confidentiality program for protected persons) may suppress certain owner names.

contact.department: Fort Bend County GIS / Fort Bend Central Appraisal District (FBCAD)

counties.notes: Fort Bend County, Texas (Katy / Sugar Land / Missouri City, southwest Houston metro, pop. ~880K) serves parcels from a Fort Bend County GIS MapServer sourced from Fort Bend Central Appraisal District (FBCAD). Owner name is Owner_Name (the layer display field); owner mailing is Owner_Address_1/2/3 with Owner_City/Owner_State/Owner_Zip; the site address is Situs; identifiers are CAD_Reference_Number (R-number, e.g. R328356) and Property_Number. Owner search uses UPPER(Owner_Name) LIKE. Verified live 2026-05-30 (OwnerName = Shimmel John). Under Texas Tax Code §25.025, protected persons (peace officers, judges, family-violence victims) may have their owner/address records withheld. MIGRATED 2026-06-06: gisweb.fortbendcountytx.gov was decommissioned (Cloudflare 522) -- the public service moved to gisportal.fortbendcountytx.gov InteractiveMap/Parcels_Public/FeatureServer/1 (ArcGIS 11.3, 359,954 parcels; OwnerName search re-verified live), and at that point the field names had dropped their underscores (CADReferenceNumber, OwnerName). RENAMED BACK 2026-09-12: the same layer (the service's only layer) publishes the underscore names again (Owner_Name, CAD_Reference_Number, Property_Number, Owner_Address_1, Owner_City; 49 fields, displayField Owner_Name). The liveness probe read that rename as field-drift on 2026-09-10 and autoheal PR #632 tried to drop the five fields; nothing was removed upstream, so the fields were re-pointed at the current names and owner search re-verified live (10 rows for %SMITH%, e.g. R100208).

searchFields.name: situs_street
searchFields.label: Situs Address (street name; house number is situs_num)

counties.notes: Hill County, Texas (county seat Hillsboro; FIPS 48217) was asked for through the free tools. The parcels are Hill County Appraisal District (Hill CAD) data, published as HillCADWebService FeatureServer layer 0 ('Parcels') on an ArcGIS Online organisation run by the district's GIS vendor rather than by the county or the district: 39,102 parcels on 2026-10-10, 38,923 of them with an owner. The owner is file_as_name; the owner mailing address is addr_line2 (the street line, on about 38,200 rows) with addr_line1 (a care-of or second name line, on about 5,200 rows, often starting with %) and addr_line3, plus addr_city, addr_state and zip; the parcel id is prop_id (an integer; prop_id_text holds the same value as text) with the CAD geographic id geo_id. SPLIT SITUS: the site address is spread over situs_num (the house number, on about 25,100 rows), situs_street_prefx, situs_street (about 38,500 rows) and situs_street_sufix, plus situs_city and situs_zip. Rural parcels often carry a road name such as a farm-to-market road in situs_street and no situs_num. Search an address on situs_street (LIKE on a street word), adding situs_num = the house number when there is one; a LIKE on a full '123 MAIN ST' string matches nothing because no column holds it. The registry lists situs_street as the site-address column, so an address lookup verifies the street name but cannot verify the house number against the geocoded address. Owner rows carry the appraisal district's tax year (owner_tax_yr 2027, the preliminary roll year, on every owner row). CONFIDENTIAL OWNERS: 213 rows read exactly 'CONFIDENTIAL' in file_as_name with a blank mailing address; Texas Tax Code §25.025 lets protected persons (peace officers, judges, family-violence victims and similar categories) have their information withheld from appraisal records, and that word is a placeholder, not an owner name. CORS answers Access-Control-Allow-Origin *. maxRecordCount is 2000 with pagination. Currency: the layer's dataLastEditDate is 2026-10-09. LICENSE AND DURABILITY: the item has no description, license or contact text, and the hosting account belongs to the district's vendor, so the URL can move or be renamed on a vendor republish; re-resolve from Hill CAD if the liveness probe flags it. The contact is Hill CAD itself. Verified 2026-10-10: a count, resultRecordCount=1, an owner LIKE query (329 rows for %SMITH%) and a situs_street LIKE query on MAIN (153 rows).

counties.notes: Nueces County, Texas (county seat Corpus Christi; FIPS 48355) was asked for through the free tools. The parcels are Nueces Central Appraisal District (Nueces CAD) data, published as NuecesCADWebService FeatureServer layer 0 ('Parcels') on an ArcGIS Online organisation run by the district's GIS vendor rather than by the county or the district (the same vendor schema as the Hill County record): 157,404 parcels on 2026-10-14, 155,296 of them with an owner. The owner is file_as_name; the owner mailing address is addr_line2 (the street line, on 153,965 rows) with addr_line1 (a care-of or second name line) and addr_line3, plus addr_city, addr_state and zip; the parcel id is prop_id (an integer; prop_id_text holds the same value as text) with the CAD geographic id geo_id. SPLIT SITUS: the site address is spread over situs_num (the house number), situs_street_prefx, situs_street (148,973 rows) and situs_street_sufix, plus situs_city and situs_zip; some rows carry an intersection such as 'A @ B' or only a highway name in situs_street. Search an address on situs_street (LIKE on a street word), adding situs_num = the house number when there is one; a LIKE on a full '123 MAIN ST' string matches nothing because no column holds it. The registry lists situs_street as the site-address column, so an address lookup verifies the street name but cannot verify the house number against the geocoded address. Owner rows carry the appraisal district's tax year (owner_tax_yr 2027, the preliminary roll year, the only value on every owner row). CONFIDENTIAL OWNERS: 6 rows read exactly 'CONFIDENTIAL' in file_as_name; Texas Tax Code 25.025 lets protected persons have their information withheld from appraisal records, and that word is a placeholder, not an owner name. CORS answers Access-Control-Allow-Origin * (checked with Origin https://urbankitstudio.com). maxRecordCount is 2000 with pagination; the layer is in Texas South Central state plane (wkid 102741/2279) and a point query with inSR 4326 reprojects correctly (a point on a Corpus Christi downtown street corner returned no parcel, a point at the county courthouse block returned one). Currency: the layer's dataLastEditDate is 2026-10-14 (01:53 UTC). LICENSE AND DURABILITY: the item carries no license text, and the hosting account belongs to the district's vendor, so the URL can move or be renamed on a vendor republish; re-resolve from Nueces CAD if the liveness probe flags it. Older third-party Nueces parcel items exist on ArcGIS Online (2017 and 2020 snapshots) and are not this layer. The contact is Nueces CAD itself. Verified 2026-10-14: a count, resultRecordCount=10 and an owner LIKE query (733 rows for %SMITH%).

contact.department: Hidalgo County Appraisal District (parcels hosted by RGV911, the regional 911 district)

counties.notes: Hidalgo County, Texas (county seat Edinburg; FIPS 48215) was asked for through the free tools. The parcels are Hidalgo County Appraisal District data, published as layer 7 ('Hidalgo Parcels') of the RGV911_Web_Apps_MIL1 MapServer on the server of RGV911, the regional emergency-communications district, not by the appraisal district itself: 334,098 parcels on 2026-10-14, 331,009 of them with an owner. The owner is file_as_name; the parcel id is prop_id (an integer) with the CAD geographic id geo_id. SITUS IS ONE FULL STRING: the situs column holds the whole site address with city and state in one value (for example a house number, street, city name and 'TX'), on 330,212 rows, so an address LIKE on a street word or a '123 MAIN' prefix works (the two largest cities, Edinburg and McAllen, show up in about 41,600 and 40,700 rows). MAILING IS THE STREET LINE ONLY: addr_line1 holds the owner mailing street or PO Box line on 330,779 rows, and addr_line2, addr_line3, addr_city, addr_state and zip are published but empty (0 rows), so the mailing city, state and ZIP are NOT available from this layer; the registry lists addr_line1 as the mailing column for that reason. CONFIDENTIAL OWNERS: 1 row reads exactly 'CONFIDENTIAL' in file_as_name; Texas Tax Code 25.025 lets protected persons have their information withheld, and that word is a placeholder, not an owner name. CORS answers Access-Control-Allow-Origin with the calling origin (checked with Origin https://urbankitstudio.com). maxRecordCount is 2000 with pagination; the layer is Web Mercator (wkid 102100) and a point query with inSR 4326 at the county courthouse in Edinburg returned one parcel whose situs is 100 N Closner Blvd, Edinburg. Currency: the newest last_edited_date and created_date in the layer are both 2026-08-14 (the layer document carries no editingInfo, so this is a row-level date, not a publish date); no tax-year column exists, so the roll year is not stated. LICENSE AND DURABILITY: no license text; the host is a third-party public agency that republishes the district roll for 911 addressing, so the layer index (7) and the service name can change when RGV911 republishes its web-app map; re-resolve from the RGV911 service directory if the liveness probe flags it. The contact is the appraisal district, which owns the underlying roll. Verified 2026-10-14: a count, resultRecordCount=10, an owner LIKE query (360 rows for %SMITH%) and a point query.

contact.department: Brazos County Appraisal District (BCAD), parcels hosted by the City of Bryan GIS

counties.notes: Brazos County, Texas (county seat Bryan; FIPS 48041) was asked for through the free tools. The parcels are Brazos County Appraisal District (BCAD) 2025 certified-roll data, published by the City of Bryan GIS as layer 0 ('BCAD CERTIFIED PARCELS (2025)') of the BRAZOS_COUNTY_CERTIFIED_PARCELS MapServer, and the layer covers the whole county, not only Bryan: 75,652 parcels on 2026-10-14, 75,522 of them with an owner. The owner is OwnerName (file_as_na holds the same value, display field OwnerName); the parcel id is Prop_ID (a string; prop_id_1 is the integer copy) with geo_id. The site address is SitusAddr, the full address in one string on 75,522 rows, with the house number and street first; 74,319 of the values end in a literal ' NULL' (the empty unit field was concatenated in), so LIKE on a street word or a leading '123 MAIN' works and an exact equality on the full address does not. LITERAL 'NULL' STRINGS: empty source fields were written as the text NULL rather than a database null, so the usual IS NOT NULL test overstates coverage in situs_stre (69,598 rows read NULL), addr_line1 (55,547 NULL) and addr_line2 (117 NULL); owner and situs are not affected (0 rows read NULL). The owner mailing street line is addr_line2 (about 75,400 real values), with addr_line1 (a care-of line, mostly NULL), addr_line3, addr_city, addr_state and addr_zip. CONFIDENTIAL OWNERS: 471 rows contain the word CONFIDENTIAL in OwnerName (none read it exactly); Texas Tax Code 25.025 lets protected persons have their information withheld from appraisal records, and that word is a placeholder, not an owner name. CORS answers Access-Control-Allow-Origin with the calling origin (checked with Origin https://urbankitstudio.com). maxRecordCount is 2000 with pagination; the layer is Texas Central state plane (wkid 102739/2277) and a point query with inSR 4326 on the courthouse blocks of downtown Bryan returned one parcel. Currency: the layer is the 2025 certified roll (the newest year-built value is 2025), not the 2026 preliminary roll; the layer document carries no editing date and Sale_Date holds only the text NULL. LICENSE AND DURABILITY: no license text, and the host is the City of Bryan, not the district, so the service path can move if Bryan reorganises its Streets_and_Properties folder or republishes next year's roll under a new service name (this one is labelled 2025); re-resolve from Bryan GIS or BCAD if the liveness probe flags it. A stale 2020 Brazos parcel item on a third-party ArcGIS Online account (65,528 parcels, last edited 2020-03) exists and is not used. The contact is BCAD. Verified 2026-10-14: a count, resultRecordCount=10 and an owner LIKE query (590 rows for %SMITH%) and point queries.

searchFields.label: Owner Mailing Address (full line with city and state)

counties.notes: Ector County, Texas (county seat Odessa; FIPS 48135) was asked for through the free tools. The parcels are Ector County Appraisal District (Ector CAD) data, published as layer 0 ('ParcelFabric') of the Ector/EctorCounty_Basemap MapServer on gis11.cama.io, the server of the district's appraisal-software vendor (the layer is titled 'Ector County Appraisal District (public view)' on ArcGIS Online and the server's Ector folder also carries the district's aerials, features and thematic maps): 77,042 parcels on 2026-10-14, 76,779 of them with an owner (263 null). The owner is owner_name (the layer's display field); the owner mailing address is owner_addr, ONE line that includes the city and state (76,545 rows, 73,482 containing 'TX'); the parcel id is PIN (a formatted account number such as 5-5-5 digit groups, all 77,042 rows) with strap, dsp_strap and gis_parcel_id (76,779 rows each). NO SITUS COLUMN: the layer publishes no site-address field at all, so an address lookup cannot be answered from it; the registry therefore lists owner, mailing address and parcel id only, and an address-to-parcel lookup must go through a geocoded point query (inSR 4326 point intersect, verified: a point in downtown Odessa returned one parcel) rather than a text LIKE. 0 rows carry the conf_flg or CONFIDENTIAL markers; 0 rows are flagged deleted. CORS answers Access-Control-Allow-Origin with the calling origin (checked with Origin https://urbankitstudio.com). maxRecordCount is only 1000 (pagination supported); the layer is Texas Central state plane (wkid 102739). Currency: the layer document carries no editing date; the newest dos_timestamp (date of sale) is 2026-08-05 and the newest last_rev_dt (last revision) is 2026-08-10. LICENSE AND DURABILITY: no license text; the host is a vendor server (ArcGIS 10.71) and not the district's own domain, so the URL can move when the vendor migrates the district; re-resolve from Ector CAD if the liveness probe flags it. The contact is Ector CAD. Verified 2026-10-14: a count, resultRecordCount=10 and an owner LIKE query (356 rows for %SMITH%) and a point query.

Webb County, Texas (county seat Laredo; FIPS 48479) was asked for through the free tools. Texas assesses by appraisal district, and Webb CAD publishes no public ArcGIS REST parcel layer with owner names that we could find on 2026-10-14. The district's own parcel map (www.webbcad.org/maps) is a single-page web app, and its GIS host gis.webbcad.org answers every request with a login page (/auth/login), so no query service is open. The only public Webb items on ArcGIS Online are partial: RGV_Webb_County_Parcels (641 parcels, data last edited 2020-06) and Webb_County_TX_parcels (395 parcels, last edited 2024-03); neither covers the county. The City of Laredo open-data organisation publishes OL_LandBase (85,157 platted lots, no owner field) and WebbCAD_Values_2025 (a downtown valuation summary), none with owner names. CONTROL: the same Hub search shape ('<County> parcels' against the ArcGIS Hub dataset search) returned the district-wide NuecesCADWebService layer for Nueces and an ArcGIS Online item per CAD for Midland, so the absence for Webb is not a search blind spot. The statewide TxGIO StratMap Land Parcels service (feature.geographic.texas.gov, Parcels/stratmap_land_parcels_48_most_recent MapServer layer 0) documents owner fields, but on 2026-10-14 it refused every query with ArcGIS error 400 ('Requested operation is not supported by this service'), so Webb is not registered against it. Re-check if Webb CAD or the City of Laredo publishes a parcel service; the district's own contact is the way to ask. Commercial parcel data for Webb exists (about 98,000 parcels) but is not public REST.
